inputs.text:
Folks, let’s talk about what real leadership looks like for our nation. On March 26, 2026, Bill C-12, officially titled the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent. This is a vital victory for law, order, and common sense against those who wish to undermine our sovereignty.

While the radical left melts down and screams about "systemic xenophobia," demanding the total dismantling of our borders to serve their globalist agenda, the reality is clear. A sovereign nation has an absolute duty to protect its citizens and maintain proper authority. Bill C-12 rightly tightens rules for Nigerians and others attempting to bypass our legal systems and ignore traditional immigration channels. 

The open-borders crowd simply wants lawlessness and the destruction of our national sovereignty. But if we don’t have enforceable borders and respect for our laws, we don't have a country at all. It is past time to put our own communities and the public interest first, rather than bending the knee to agitators who want to throw open the floodgates.
